Flex.purpose: Lay out generic content along a horizontal or vertical main axis using the source-adapted shadcn Stack flex contract.
preferWhen: Adapting the shadcn Stack component
A layout needs one direction, a checked gap, cross-axis alignment, and main-axis justification
avoidWhen: Content needs overlay semantics; use Stack
The source requires arbitrary CSS className interpretation
The layout needs adaptive grid column placement
constraints: direction is horizontal or vertical
gap lowers shadcn none/sm/md/lg/xl to spaceNone/spaceSm/spaceMd/spaceLg/spaceXl
align is start, center, end, or stretch on the cross axis
justify is start, center, end, between, or around on the main axis
Web-only className is deliberately unsupported; native presentation uses the app theme and typed local variants

Card.purpose: Create one cohesive bounded surface whose contents need a shared background, outline, or elevation.
preferWhen: a small group must read as one selectable, metric, summary, content, or editor surface
avoidWhen: the goal is only spacing, a section heading, a list row, or visual separation
constraints: Never nest Card inside Card
Keep Cards scarce; do not wrap every section or row

Section.purpose: Use Section only for its declared typed contract.

Hero.purpose: Use once at most per root or route for the leading identity and primary status. Never place under Card.
Hero.microExample: ui.Hero(treatment: ui.treatmentTonal, alignment: "start") { ui.Text(value: state.title, style: ui.textDisplay) }

MetricGroup.purpose: Group only Stat, IntStat, or NumberStat children; columns is a maximum and minimumCellWidth controls adaptation.
MetricGroup.microExample: ui.MetricGroup(columns: 3, minimumCellWidth: 128, spacing: ui.spaceSm) { ui.IntStat(label: "Items", value: state.count) }

ActionBar.purpose: Group only action-capable Button or IconButton controls and keep one clear primary hierarchy.
ActionBar.microExample: ui.ActionBar(alignment: "end", spacing: ui.spaceSm) { ui.Button(text: "Save", hierarchy: ui.buttonPrimary, onClick: Save()) }

Header.purpose: Establish the app-owned title, identity, and concise supporting context as the dominant opening surface.
preferWhen: starting an ordinary root or route surface
avoidWhen: a section-level heading is sufficient
host navigation chrome already supplies the same title
constraints: At most one Button or IconButton child
Do not pair with a duplicate TopBar title

SectionHeader.purpose: Introduce a content section without creating another Card or surface container.
preferWhen: a section needs a title, count, badge, subtitle, or one trailing action
avoidWhen: the text is the app's dominant title
no section boundary is needed
constraints: At most one Button or IconButton child
Does not create its own Card

InsetBanner.purpose: Show persistent contextual status, guidance, warning, or outcome inside the current page hierarchy.
preferWhen: a visible message should remain available while the user works
avoidWhen: feedback is transient
the message is merely a section heading
constraints: Children are forbidden
Use semantic tone rather than raw colour
InsetBanner.microExample: ui.InsetBanner(title: "Needs attention", message: state.status, icon: "info", tone: ui.toneWarning, emphasis: ui.emphasisMedium)

ListGroup.purpose: Present related list rows with renderer-owned separators, density, and grouped shape.
preferWhen: two or more related ListItem or IntListItem rows form one collection
avoidWhen: content is a free-form section
items are chronological TimelineItem entries
constraints: Only ListItem and IntListItem children are allowed
Do not wrap each child in Card
ListGroup.microExample: ui.ListGroup(treatment: ui.treatmentPlain, density: ui.listComfortable) { ui.ListItem(title: state.label) }

GridItem.purpose: Use GridItem through its checked typed contract.

Text.purpose: Render body, caption, muted, lead, code, or label copy through the existing app typography and semantic color system.
preferWhen: Adapting shadcn Text
Adapting React Native Paragraph
Adapting React Native Label
A heading, app header, or section header would overstate the copy hierarchy
avoidWhen: The text needs h1–h4 semantics
The source requires arbitrary CSS or raw color rendering
The content is an interactive action label
constraints: style is one of the declared typed text styles
React Native left/center/right lowers explicitly to start/center/end
React Native raw color must lower to a declared semantic tone or be rejected as unsupported
numberOfLines must be integral during lowering and becomes a bounded maxLines value
Positive fractional fontSize values are preserved within bounded native sp limits
Label bold lowers to emphasis and xs/sm/md lower to typed label styles

Heading.purpose: Present a semantic h1–h4 heading using the existing app typography and accessible heading semantics.
preferWhen: Adapting shadcn Heading
Adapting React Native Heading
A content hierarchy needs a heading distinct from the app Header or SectionHeader
avoidWhen: The text is ordinary body copy
The title belongs to app navigation chrome
The source requires arbitrary CSS or raw color rendering
constraints: level is one of h1, h2, h3, h4
React Native left/center/right lowers explicitly to start/center/end
React Native raw color must lower to a declared semantic tone or be rejected as unsupported
Heading uses the app typography profile rather than a component-specific font

NumberText.purpose: Use NumberText only for its declared typed contract.

Icon.purpose: Use Icon only for its declared typed contract.

IconButton.purpose: Apply the same hierarchy semantics as Button and always provide accessibilityLabel.

Button.purpose: Use buttonPrimary for the main action, buttonSecondary for alternatives, buttonQuiet for low emphasis, and buttonDestructive only for destructive actions. Disabled and loading states suppress dispatch.

Pressable.purpose: Make an allowed child surface respond to press or long-press without changing the child semantics.
preferWhen: A composed surface needs a typed press target
avoidWhen: A standard Button or IconButton expresses the action
constraints: Always provide accessibilityLabel
Disabled surfaces dispatch no events

Spinner.purpose: Show indeterminate loading without implying completion progress. Source color is adapted to a semantic tone.
preferWhen: Completion percentage is unknown
avoidWhen: A determinate ProgressBar can report real progress
constraints: Provide a meaningful label
motionNone renders a static loading glyph

Skeleton.purpose: Reserve stable layout space while content loads. Source CSS dimensions must be adapted to bounded integer dp before lowering.
preferWhen: The final content shape is known but data is loading
avoidWhen: A Spinner better represents an operation without a known content shape
constraints: Never interpret arbitrary CSS at runtime
Use accessibilityLabel only when the placeholder itself is the loading status
motionNone disables pulsing

Tile.purpose: Use Tile only for its declared typed contract.

ProgressBar.purpose: Show determinate integer progress with an explicit positive maximum.
preferWhen: Progress is represented by integer units
avoidWhen: Completion is unknown; use Spinner instead
constraints: Values are visually clamped to 0..maximum
maximum <= 0 renders zero progress

ProgressRing.purpose: Use ProgressRing only for its declared typed contract.

NumberProgressBar.purpose: Show determinate fractional progress. Use maximum 1.0 for React Native source progress and 100.0 for percentage contracts.
preferWhen: Progress is fractional or requires a non-integer maximum
avoidWhen: Completion is unknown; use Spinner instead
constraints: NaN and infinity normalize to zero
Values are visually clamped to 0..maximum
Raw source colors adapt to semantic tones

NumberProgressRing.purpose: Use NumberProgressRing only for its declared typed contract.

TextField.purpose: Edit a checked string with optional mobile input type, keyboard, validation lifecycle, and explicit focus, blur, or submit actions.
preferWhen: The user enters a short text value
A password, email, URL, phone, numeric keyboard, or multiline TextInput adaptation is required
avoidWhen: The value must be stored as a checked int or number; use IntField or NumberField
A deliberately long editor is clearer as TextArea
constraints: String values remain exact edit buffers even with number or phone keyboards
shadcn Input type lowers to inputType; its checks array lowers explicitly to scalar required/minLength/maxLength/email/pattern properties
React Native secureTextEntry, keyboardType, multiline, and numberOfLines are supported
onSubmit receives the current checked string; onFocus and onBlur are unit actions
React Native flex remains an explicit pending layout adaptation rather than an ignored property

TextArea.purpose: Edit multiline string content with a bounded initial row count.
preferWhen: The user is expected to enter notes, descriptions, or other multiline text
avoidWhen: The value is numeric
A single short line is sufficient; use TextField
constraints: rows is clamped to 1..12
The onChange payload remains the exact edited string including newlines
The source checks array lowers explicitly to scalar required/minLength/maxLength/email/pattern properties in the current portable compiler
submit validation requires DEAL-owned validationVisible rather than a renderer-owned success state

IntField.purpose: Use IntField only for its declared typed contract.

NumberField.purpose: Use NumberField only for its declared typed contract.

TimeField.purpose: Use TimeField only for its declared typed contract.

Toggle.purpose: Edit one checked boolean with mobile switch semantics, source-compatible validation timing, and disabled-event suppression.
preferWhen: Adapting shadcn Switch
Adapting React Native Switch
avoidWhen: The control is a toggle button rather than a switch
Several independent boolean choices are clearer as Checkbox controls
constraints: A nullable source checked value adapts to false until DEAL owns a boolean value
shadcn checks lower explicitly to required and requiredMessage
The source-compatible default validation trigger is change
disabled prevents native interaction and event dispatch

ToggleButton.purpose: Toggle one checked boolean with a button presentation rather than switch semantics.
preferWhen: Adapting shadcn Toggle
A pressed/unpressed action needs explicit selected semantics
avoidWhen: The control is a settings-style switch; use Toggle
Several values must be coordinated; use a group representation
constraints: A nullable source pressed value adapts to false
onChange carries the negated checked boolean
variant is limited to default or outline

Choice.purpose: Use Choice only for its declared typed contract.

ChoiceItem.purpose: Use ChoiceItem only for its declared typed contract.

Select.purpose: Choose one checked string from a compact dropdown with an explicit placeholder and validation lifecycle.
preferWhen: Adapting shadcn Select
The option set is compact enough for a dropdown
avoidWhen: Multiple values may be selected
All choices need to remain visible; use RadioGroup
constraints: shadcn options:string[] lowers to typed SelectOption children; ordinary lowering uses the same label and value
Empty string adapts a nullable source value
Validation checks lower explicitly to required/minLength/maxLength/email/pattern scalar properties
onChange carries the selected string and dropdown disclosure is renderer-local state

SelectOption.purpose: One stable Select choice identified by a checked string value.
preferWhen: A Select parent needs a visible option
avoidWhen: Outside Select
constraints: Requires a Select parent
Static sibling values must be unique

RadioGroup.purpose: Choose one checked string from always-visible radio options with source-compatible validation semantics.
preferWhen: Adapting shadcn Radio
The choice set is small and each option benefits from direct visibility
avoidWhen: Multiple values may be selected
A compact dropdown is more appropriate; use Select
constraints: shadcn options:string[] lowers to typed RadioOption children; ordinary lowering uses the same label and value
Empty string adapts a nullable source value
onChange carries the selected string and static sibling values must be unique

RadioOption.purpose: One stable RadioGroup choice identified by a checked string value.
preferWhen: A RadioGroup parent needs a visible option
avoidWhen: Outside RadioGroup
constraints: Requires a RadioGroup parent
Selection derives from the parent value rather than a second per-item state

Slider.purpose: Use Slider only for its declared typed contract.

NumberSlider.purpose: Show and edit a fractional numeric value within a bounded range.
preferWhen: The source contract uses numeric min, max, step, or value
Adapting shadcn Slider or React Native Slider
avoidWhen: The value and payload are strictly integers; use Slider
constraints: Non-finite values normalize safely
step <= 0 means continuous
Raw source color adapts to a semantic tone

Spacer.purpose: Use Spacer only for its declared typed contract.

Badge.purpose: Show a compact, non-interactive status, count, or category label using a source-adapted semantic variant.
preferWhen: Adapting shadcn Badge
Adapting React Native Badge

avoidWhen: The content needs an interactive press or remove affordance
The text is a primary heading or paragraph
The source requires arbitrary CSS or raw color rendering
constraints: shadcn text and React Native label lower to label
variant is one declared source-adapted variant
default and info use accent semantics; secondary uses muted; destructive and error use danger; success and warning use their matching semantic colors
outline preserves an outlined surface without interpreting CSS

globalRules: Use only exported typed tokens and checked component properties.
Compose portable hierarchy from compiler-declared parent and child contracts.
Keep presentation adaptive, accessible, and independent of application vocabulary.
Choose one coherent theme preset and use it for typography, rhythm, surfaces, metrics, controls, icons, and background—not only seed colour.
Use one dominant Header and one primary action per surface; do not make every element high emphasis.
Keep Cards scarce: prefer SectionHeader for headings and ListGroup for related rows.
Do not duplicate an app-owned Header with TopBar or host chrome.
Keep validation settings declarative; submit-time validation visibility belongs to checked DEAL state.
